name: Howey-in-the-Hills
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Howey-in-the-Hills?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes. Plain golf carts only on streets the town has designated, and that list is not drawn here. Howey-in-the-Hills police require every golf cart to be registered each year. Until the street list is on the map, plan on an LSV.

rules.rule: The town ordinance and state law require golf carts to be registered each calendar year
Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Howey-in-the-Hills?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Do I need a sticker in Howey-in-the-Hills?
faq.a: Yes. Police say registration opens January 1 and the sticker goes on the rear of the cart.

faq.q: Why are the streets red for a golf cart?
faq.a: Florida allows golf carts only on designated streets. The town's list is not digitized, so those streets are not shown as golf cart roads.
